title: Extending delegable VCS ops needs four coordinated edits
summary: Making a vcs op charter-delegable requires: (1) delegable flag in external-vcs.ts, (2) grant union + parser in external-operation-target.ts, (3) target construction in external-operation-runtime.ts, (4) the resolver whitelist in execute(). Missing any one leaves the op silently non-delegable.

expected_outcome: vcs:pr_merge and vcs:push were made delegable with repository+branch grant targets. ssh/git@ remote urls must be normalized before parse (grants are https-only). reputational_class distinguishes publish-grade ops (A) from PR creation (B).
